newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA ASK ROBSON TO LEAVE, NEWSPAPER SAYS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA ASK ROBSON TO LEAVE, NEWSPAPER SAYS.

text.p: Barcelona have asked coach Bobby Robson to leave, Spanish newspaper AS said on Saturday.

It said Barcelona president Jose Luis Nunez and vice-president Joan Gaspart asked Robson to resign last Monday, 24 hours after the club lost 2-0 to Espanyol, leaving them eight points adrift of Spanish league leaders Real Madrid.
The club officials held a five-hour meeting with Robson on Monday night, after which the coach said he believed he still had the backing of the board.
AS said Nunez and Gaspart had agreed with Robson to defer a decision on his future. But it added that Nunez was hoping that Robson would resign instead of being fired.
Two weeks ago, the Barcelona board said it had "absolute and complete" confidence in the former England manager and Gaspart said he expected Robson to be with the club for many years.
Robson, 63, signed a two-year contract with Barcelona last May.
